integrity: A self-contained combinatorial proof gives the infinite-family statement; exhaustive finite checks cover n=4 through 10 only. The minimum-cardinality value is attributed to the existing 2026 theorem, not presented as novel. Historical priority is qualified; no independent review was performed.
scientific_limitations: Counts only minimum total dominating vertex sets of J(n,2) for integer n>=4 with the n-point ground set labelled. Larger cardinalities, higher Johnson ranks, automorphism quotients, and independent historical-priority validation are not addressed.
title: Extremal forests and exact counts for total domination in triangular graphs
